author: packs
description: D21-T10: calls made, connect rate, talk time, outcomes and meetings booked per person, list and day, over the last 90 days of call attempts.
name: sales-calling-metrics

definition.name: Calling: Calls per Person per Day
definition.sql: SELECT m.claimed_by AS user_ref, date_trunc('day', a.created_at)::date AS day, COUNT(*)::bigint AS calls FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY m.claimed_by, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC, calls DESC

target.query: Calling: Calls per Person per Day

definition.name: Calling: Connect Rate per Person per Week
definition.sql: SELECT m.claimed_by AS user_ref, date_trunc('week', a.created_at)::date AS week, COUNT(*)::bigint AS calls, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.outcome = 'connected') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS connect_rate_pct FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY m.claimed_by, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Connect Rate per Person per Week

definition.name: Calling: Talk Time per Person per Day
definition.sql: SELECT m.claimed_by AS user_ref, date_trunc('day', a.created_at)::date AS day, COALESCE(SUM(a.duration_seconds), 0)::numeric AS talk_seconds FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY m.claimed_by, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Talk Time per Person per Day

definition.name: Calling: Outcomes per List
definition.sql: SELECT m.list_ref, a.outcome, COUNT(*)::bigint AS calls FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY m.list_ref, a.outcome ORDER BY m.list_ref, calls DESC

definition.name: Calling: Meetings Booked per Person per Week
definition.sql: SELECT m.claimed_by AS user_ref, date_trunc('week', a.created_at)::date AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT act.id)::bigint AS meetings FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref JOIN activity act ON act.record_id::text = m.record_id AND act.activity_type = 'meeting' AND act.created_at >= a.created_at AND act.created_at < a.created_at + INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY m.claimed_by, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Meetings Booked per Person per Week

title: Pack: team calling metrics
